reference_root: Canonical KAYAN development checkout. Narrow feature branches may omit historical research files.

criteria.requirement: Planner, Recon, Web-App, Network and Reporting have distinct capabilities and auditable assignment, outcome and recovery states.
criteria.evidence: The five-role implementation is present and historical owned-lab examples exist. Current full-workflow failure and recovery cases were not rerun.

criteria.requirement: Verify signed ROE and independently authorize each operation with action-specific Rust/Cedar decisions and auditable outcomes. Missing or invalid authorization must fail closed.
criteria.evidence: Ubuntu CI passed 180 tools and 10 Go TrustGate tests, with the live Cedar test skipped. Executor bookkeeping tests do not measure live authorization.

criteria.requirement: Bind source captures, approved review, custody and admission to the same case and revision. Reject tampering, forged approvals and cross-case reuse.
criteria.evidence: Completed synthetic and saved loopback fixtures cover capture, receipt replay and restoration. Independent operational custody and reviewer enrollment are pending.

criteria.requirement: Admit a finding only with the complete reviewed provenance required by admission v2. Withhold unsupported, ambiguous and contradicted claims per occurrence.
criteria.evidence: Documented independent engineering sign-off covers the bounded offline verifier using synthetic inputs. Real-telemetry intake remains NO-GO.

criteria.requirement: Compare grounded ATT&CK generation against separate retrieval, occurrence, source, role and complete evidence oracles.
criteria.evidence: Diagnostic top-5 runs scored 22/32 exact for field BM25 and 26/32 for hybrid. Experiment D yielded 0/3 complete groups in both mapping arms. Better technique selection has not established better proof assembly.

criteria.requirement: Measure Planner assignment, dependencies, intent, recovery, loops and unnecessary operations independently from deterministic Phase 1 planning.
criteria.evidence: The historical closed-world inference benchmark reported 24/30 first pass and 26/30 after correction. Cases were authored and supplied runtime constraints; the score does not establish held-out accuracy.

criteria.requirement: Measure Recon attribution and coverage, Web-App finding and remediation fidelity, and Network observation accuracy and scope fidelity with distinct oracles.
metrics: false positives and false negatives by role
criteria.evidence: Existing coordination and reports cover selected synthetic cases. Independent per-role quality scores and a held-out evaluation are unestablished.

criteria.requirement: Allow bounded provider selection for defensive Reporting under digest-specific approval, independent egress authorization and deterministic admission.
criteria.evidence: One historical authorized Slate request returned a valid excerpt and control selection and the browser export matched. The smoke test does not measure generation of independently grounded findings.

criteria.requirement: Measure local, cloud and role-specific configurations with safe provider substitution, structured outputs, independent authorization and attributable results.
metrics: accuracy, latency, token use and spend by role
criteria.evidence: The actual sequential assessment uses local Ollama. Experimental cloud dispatch is paused. Archived Reporting is the only demonstrated real cloud workflow. There is no active approval for a new cloud request.

criteria.requirement: Recover a verified local report after interruption of an approved cloud attempt without reissuing the request.
criteria.evidence: An interrupted transport call previously returned no saved result (404). The same evidence revision now returns the degraded local report after app recreation and rejects replay. A separate mock exceeded a 0.2-second total deadline across individually shorter waits and also recovered the fallback without retry.

criteria.requirement: Display verified provider metadata from a saved report, including genuine zero reasoning tokens. Omit cloud metrics for local output and degraded fallback.
criteria.evidence: Rendered-HTML assertions and the production build passed. The browser visual check remains pending.

criteria.requirement: Export the exact report bytes loaded by the console, or reject the export and prompt review after custody or saved output changes.
criteria.evidence: A stale export previously returned the next custody decision's report with HTTP 200. A digest-bound export now returns HTTP 409 until the operator loads the current report. Runs, views and matching exports have identical bytes and hashes.

criteria.requirement: Exercise restart recovery, concurrency, cancellation, provider outage, egress restrictions and audit integrity across relevant Python, Go, Rust and frontend suites.
criteria.evidence: Focused recovery, Go CI and saved console operational evidence exist. No matched current cross-component reliability run was performed.

criteria.requirement: Freeze matched local, cloud and hybrid comparisons with held-out case families, independent ground truth, uncertainty analysis and negative controls.
criteria.evidence: Exposed diagnostics and authored oracles exist. No independently labelled and adjudicated fresh confirmation or frozen stakeholder thresholds have been verified.

criteria.requirement: Retain frozen inputs, model parameters, raw outcomes, scoring commands and historical failures. Report findings at the scope supported by the evidence.
criteria.evidence: The historical v2 and D reports record reproducible checks and negative outcomes. Several supporting sources and artifacts are unpublished in the local checkout.

criteria.requirement: Validate operator/reviewer identity, protected keys, service isolation, secure storage, monitoring, bounded concurrency, deployment, incident recovery and real custody independently.
criteria.evidence: Only bounded offline engineering and test-only review exchange are established. Data intake, external custody, reviewer independence and production readiness remain open.
